basis: Kit 0.6.13 (27 Nov 2026): docs/event-ladder.md. Event reports only; measurements and judgments are outside the ladder.

rule.text: ladder-1: a report is a lead until a reviewer confirms it or it is verified by two independent origins, an official source within its own remit, or a published geolocation; a party's claims and state media count as one origin per government and never verify or raise an item alone

states.label: Lead
states.meaning: Reported by one origin and screened into scope, but not checked. Read it as reported, not as fact.

states.label: Confirmed
states.meaning: A reviewer judged it a real event within scope. It still rests on one origin: nothing independent has checked it.

states.label: Verified
states.meaning: Checked independently: two or more independent origins, an official source within its own remit, or a published geolocation.

basis_labels.official: an official source within its own remit

party_claim.label: Party claim
party_claim.meaning: Rests only on a party to the conflict describing its own action or an adversary's loss. It raises nothing on its own.

state_media.label: State media
state_media.meaning: Rests only on media a state owns or controls. It raises nothing on its own.

coverage.rule: several: 3 or more independent groups; few: 1 or 2; no_independent: none, but sources were read and set aside or not counted; none: not monitored
